variants.text: You're enjoying lunch when you spot a cockroach hiding in your food.
performanceSteps: Enjoy your lunch
Recoil in disgust and push the food away.

variants.text: You're enjoying lunch when you discover a heart-shaped fried egg tucked into your meal.
performanceSteps: Enjoy your lunch
Smile at the surprise and admire it fondly.

variants.text: You lift some noodles with chopsticks, but they seem to go on forever. Raise your hand higher and higher, searching for the end.
performanceSteps: Lift noodles with chopsticks
Keep lifting the endless noodles and look for the end.

variants.text: You lift some noodles with chopsticks, but they break into tiny pieces. Lean close to the bowl and carefully gather the pieces.
performanceSteps: Lift noodles with chopsticks
Lean toward the bowl and gather the broken noodles.

variants.text: You raise a spoonful of soup, but it's steaming hot. Pull your mouth back and patiently blow on it.
performanceSteps: Raise a spoonful of soup
Pull back from the hot soup and blow gently to cool it.

variants.text: You raise a spoonful of soup, but it's as cold as ice water. Hunch your shoulders, touch your throat, and rub your hands to warm up.
performanceSteps: Raise a spoonful of soup
Shiver at the cold soup and rub your hands together.

groups.sharedAction: Pull the lid off a lunch box

variants.text: You pull the lid off a lunch box and it suddenly flies away. Freeze in surprise, follow it with your eyes, and reach out to catch it.
performanceSteps: Pull the lid off a lunch box
Look around for the flying lid and reach out to catch it.

variants.text: You try to pull the lid off a lunch box, but it won't budge. Tug from different angles, then stop to rub your wrist.
performanceSteps: Pull the lid off a lunch box
Tug at the stuck lid from different angles, then rub your wrist.

groups.sharedAction: Pick kernels off an ear of corn

variants.text: You pick kernels off an ear of corn, but they fall off at the slightest touch. Quickly catch them in your other hand and gather the ones you missed.
performanceSteps: Pick kernels off an ear of corn
Catch the falling kernels and pick up the ones you missed.

variants.text: You pick kernels off an ear of corn, but they won't come loose. Wiggle one from side to side, then shake out your aching hand.
performanceSteps: Pick kernels off an ear of corn
Wiggle a stuck kernel, then shake out your sore hand.

variants.text: You try to cut a slice of cake, but it collapses at the slightest touch. Pull back, then gently support it with both hands.
performanceSteps: Cut a slice of cake
Pull back from the collapsing cake and gently hold up its sides.

variants.text: You try to cut a slice of cake, but it's too hard to cut. Hold the top, saw back and forth, then stare at it in confusion.
performanceSteps: Cut a slice of cake
Saw at the rock-hard cake, then stare at it in confusion.
